knowledge_entries.name: reception_area_orientation
knowledge_entries.text: The reception zone features a branded totem and an interactive kiosk to welcome visitors and provide initial orientation about the company and booth layout. Visitors can get basic information and directions here.

knowledge_entries.name: basic_company_information_at_reception
knowledge_entries.text: Visitors can learn about the company's mission, values, and overview at the reception area via the totem and kiosk, which offer concise introductory content to help understand the company culture.

knowledge_entries.name: booth_navigation_assistance
knowledge_entries.text: The reception area provides guidance to visitors on how to navigate the booth, including directions to benefits info, recruiting, demo, and refreshment zones using the interactive kiosk and signage.

knowledge_entries.name: employee_benefits_information
knowledge_entries.text: The benefits info zone offers detailed panels and interactive terminals presenting employee benefits such as health plans, retirement options, and wellness programs, highlighting the company's supportive culture.

knowledge_entries.name: wellbeing_programs_overview
knowledge_entries.text: Information panels and terminals in the benefits zone explain the company's commitment to employee wellbeing, including mental health resources, flexible work policies, and fitness initiatives.

knowledge_entries.name: interactive_benefits_terminals
knowledge_entries.text: User-friendly touchscreen terminals allow visitors to explore detailed benefits information interactively, with options to view FAQs, videos, and personalized content about company culture and perks.

knowledge_entries.name: job_openings_and_recruiting_info
knowledge_entries.text: The recruiting zone features interactive terminals and posters displaying current job openings, company roles, and recruiting events. Seating is available for discussions with recruiting staff.

knowledge_entries.name: job_application_guidance
knowledge_entries.text: Visitors can use recruiting terminals to learn about the application process, submit applications, and receive assistance from recruiting agents seated nearby to answer questions and provide support.

knowledge_entries.name: career_development_opportunities
knowledge_entries.text: Recruiting materials highlight career paths, growth opportunities, and training programs available within the company, helping visitors understand potential long-term prospects.

knowledge_entries.name: product_showcase_and_demonstrations
knowledge_entries.text: The showcase zone displays company products including fitness equipment with detailed info steles. Demo technicians guide visitors through hands-on demonstrations to engage interest.

knowledge_entries.name: vr_ar_demo_stations
knowledge_entries.text: Two VR/AR stations provide immersive experiences demonstrating company technology. Visitors can try interactive simulations with assistance from demo technicians.

knowledge_entries.name: demo_kiosk_interaction
knowledge_entries.text: Interactive demo kiosks offer touchscreen access to product videos, specs, and company information. Demo technicians support visitors in navigating these kiosks for an engaging experience.

knowledge_entries.name: lounge_seating_and_comfort
knowledge_entries.text: The refreshment zone includes comfortable lounge seating where visitors can relax and have informal conversations, enhancing their comfort during the visit.

knowledge_entries.name: refreshment_counter_and_seating
knowledge_entries.text: A sleek refreshment counter serves beverages and snacks. Bar stools provide seating for visitors to enjoy refreshments in a casual setting.

knowledge_entries.name: hospitality_and_visitor_services
knowledge_entries.text: Hospitality agents manage the refreshment area, ensuring visitors receive attentive service and a welcoming atmosphere to enhance their overall experience at the booth.
